newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Black says Australian economy in good shape.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Black says Australian economy in good shape.

text.p: Conrad Black, the largest shareholder in John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, said on Wednesday that the Australian economy was in good shape compared with other economies in which he has newspaper interests.
"I think the economy looks alright,...but it seems to be a confidence problem," Black told reporters after Fairfax's annual meeting.
"Comparing it with others, the unemployment rate is higher than the United States, but lower than Britain and Canada," Black said. Black's Hollinger International Inc owns 25 percent of Fairfax.
The Reserve Bank of Australia earlier eased monetary policy, dropping its overnight cash rate target to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent, due to the improved outlook for inflation.
But the Australian opposition, the Labor party, said the cut was due to a sluggish Australian economy.

Earlier, Fairfax chairman Sir Laurence Street told shareholders at the annual meeting that business decisions are being inhibited by some lack of confidence in sectors critical to the group's business.
